name: interior-specifics/booking
title: Booking Scheduler
description: The consultation request form beside the live Calendly scheduler (set the Calendly URL in Settings → Interior Specifics), or an "Instant scheduling" card with phone and WhatsApp until it is connected.

intro.default: Share your preferred date and time and we'll confirm within 24 hours. Prefer to pick a slot instantly? Use the scheduler.

successBody.default: Thank you — we'll confirm your consultation by email or phone within 24 hours.

fallbackBody.default: Live calendar booking will appear here once connected. In the meantime, the request form gets you the same result — we'll confirm your slot personally.
